scope: Pure Python arithmetic, captured netlists and read-only primary upstream sources. No native run, geometry/reference edit, deck modification, or LVS acceptance.
method: scripts/io_tap_contract_audit.py recursively maps ordered subcircuit ports, preserves globals and local net scopes, and exactly sums explicit tap A/P with Decimal.
parameter_policy: Explicit A and exactly P/Perim are required. Only validated legacy R plus paired W/L metadata are additionally accepted, following pinned custom_reader explicit A/P precedence. Unknown parameters, tap multipliers and parameterized/multiplied child instances are rejected. Prior source and receipts are preserved in history-v1.
new_finding_latest_references: Superseded on 2026-10-02: the earlier helper incorrectly treated every name ending in ! as global. The local Vdd reference explicitly declares .GLOBAL sub!, and its original A/P deltas replay unchanged. Pinned main and dev references do not declare that global; their child well nodes remain distinct and the one-combined-tap-per-tie comparison now correctly rejects them. Their topology or combined A/P equivalence to the local reference is not established. No library update has demonstrated strict Vdd LVS closure.

assumptions: Only external metal connectivity changes; tap-recognition masks and extracted tap parameters remain fixed.
TIE and WELL ordering remains unchanged; the pinned parallel combiner sums A and P.
The iovss$1-to-iovss alias is hypothetical; this audit proves no physical join or well-net equivalence.
connection_only_counterfactual.conclusion: If only external metal connectivity changes and extracted tap masks/parameters remain fixed, joining the two IOVSS components cannot close strict A/P comparison. The independent VSS mismatch also remains. This does not predict an actual parent extraction with changed overlapping recognition regions.

deep_flat_partition.interpretation: Deep child-plus-parent A/P is not equal to flat geometry extraction. Upstream documents cell-local tap extraction and overlapping tap concerns. Exact overlap/region attribution for these numbers is not proven by this pure audit; substituting one sum for the other is invalid.

required_independent_inputs: A version-coherent vendor IO layout/reference bundle with an authoritative strict tap A/P definition for arbitrary perforated/overlapping tap shapes, plus a passing positive and failing A/P/polarity regression.

The actual physical parent geometry that connects the exposed IOVSS pieces, using explicit ordered pin maps and preserving distinct VSS/IOVSS domains; four of six Vdd LEF ports were mapped previously, two middle ports remain unmapped in the simplified native database.

If the authoritative IO contract instead requires abstract or virtual connectivity, an explicit separately named acceptance boundary is necessary; it cannot be reported as strict transistor-level full-chip LVS.
